admin_dashboard.purpose: Internal CRM lead management & editable company contact details
widgets: Lead Metrics Cards (Total Leads, Qualified, Consultations Requested, Conversion Rate)
Lead Table & Status Pipeline (New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal Sent, Won, Lost)
Lead Source & Software Type Breakdown Charts
Lead Search, Filter, Notes, and Follow-up Date Picker
Editable Settings Panel (Update WhatsApp number, Email, Office Address, Business Hours)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design reflects an elite tech consultancy: deep navy (#101D35), cream (#F7F4ED), accent blue (#4965E9).
Provide a smooth light/dark mode switcher stored in React state or localStorage.
Use designed visual mockups for GymBoss_VVO and software previews rather than raw generic unformatted images.
Implement the full multi-step lead form with budget selectors (Under ₹50K, ₹50K–₹1.5L, ₹1.5L–₹5L, ₹5L+, Not Sure) and lead storage.

Build the Admin Dashboard with stats, lead pipeline table with status dropdowns (New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal Sent, Won, Lost), search, filters, notes, and an editable settings panel for contact details (WhatsApp, email, address).
Keep floating WhatsApp button visible across main pages with quick pre-filled message support.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and key status elements for automated testing.
